name: One Day : Replay
source:
Immerse yourself in a gripping narrative adventure with One Day: Replay, where every moment matters and your decision counts. Unravel a chilling mystery in this heart-pounding visual novel, as you step into the shoes of a determined man on a mission to save his beloved girlfriend. You have just one day, trapped in a time loop, to alter the course of fate—over and over again. Discover multiple endings as you try to break the cycle.

Storyline: Your journey begins on an ordinary day. As you navigate through the day, you’ll face challenges, and make choices that impact the fate of your girlfriend and your own future. But be warned—every time your girlfriend’s life is lost, the day resets, and you must start again. Can you make the right decisions to break the cycle and secure a happy ending?

[From [url=https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.onedayreplay.id]Play Store[/url]]
